test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 02
subject: general
question: Which of the following rivers is an underground river at Triveni Sangam in Prayagraj?
solution: Ganga and Yamuna are the two physical rivers and Saraswati is an invisible river. The Saraswati remains hidden, but the faithful believe that she makes her presence felt underwater. During the monsoon, when the rivers are in full flow, the confluence is seen clearly due to the force of the water.
